decisions.reason: As a low-cost option to access green startups and with continued homepage prominence, it remains valuable to keep open while uncertainty resolves.
Its flagship status and own-page presence indicate ongoing commitment, and the high uncertainty of bio-based binders still warrants keeping the option alive.
Being close to the established offer and still featured on the home page, this option is relatively low-cost to maintain and its waste-to-value potential has not been disproven.
